description: Attach an asset_id to one of your entities. An asset uploaded without an entity is attached as is; one already on an entity gets a linked copy (the original row stays). Roles: original | processed | thumbnail | cover | document | receipt | certificate | other (photo is stored as original). Legacy: pass url instead of asset_id. ($0.10; API key required)

description.description: Caption for the attached asset (kept on a linked copy too).

metadata.description: Free-form metadata, merged into the stored metadata (metadata.source becomes the asset source).

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

url.description: A web link (https://…) to an image. Not a storage path: upload a file, then attach its asset_id.

name: attach_asset

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.
